corrective_scope: Read-only audit of already-written checkpoint; no rebuild, rerun, recopy or overwrite.

creation_observation.exact_message: Split-Path: Parameter set cannot be resolved using the specified named parameters. One or more parameters issued cannot be used together or an insufficient number of parameters were provided.
creation_observation.cause: The initial checkpoint-parent checks combined Split-Path -LiteralPath with -Parent. This invalid parameter combination was not an authorization denial.
creation_observation.subsequent_actions: The fresh directory creation and per-source/per-destination ancestor checks ran, all 23 copies were hash-compared, and the manifest was written. No source or output was overwritten.
